method: Static PE parsing, per-sample atomscan and cleave facts, Rizin native call/control-flow review, Capstone call-site checks, dnfile/dncil resolved CIL, resource/overlay extraction and XOR configuration decoding. No sample was executed.
external_sources: All three supplied tria.ge pages were inaccessible. Judgements rest on local bytes; filenames, ML and sandbox labels were treated as leads.
counting: Hostile/suspicious findings are counted per analyzed unit and summed across outer files and embedded members, including third-party findings. Same trait in two different units counts twice.
consumer_audit: No exact consumer referenced the input-only rule. Whole exfiltration selectors retain membership; the sole input/multi-source directory selector consumer includes both and is scoped to Python, while this rule targets PE/DLL.

Eight preexisting exact schedule references in six YAML files were updated without changing their predicates or proximity. No direct scheduled/task-trigger directory selector was found; parent autorun membership is unchanged. Effective matcher/default dictionaries were compared and are identical except corrected IDs/descriptions.
No matcher was narrowed, severity reduced or positive detection discarded. The schedule atom now describes /SC MINUTE or HOURLY without inferring the /MO interval.

samples.identification: Modified XMRig miner with appended Go downloader and Cobalt Strike Beacon
samples.marker: Modified XMRig bundle: clone-launch loop and embedded Beacon
evidence: PE64 with already unpacked code in UPX0: entry 0x14009a338 reaches CRT main dispatch; call 0x14009a2c3 enters the modified miner main near 0x14002ade0.

Main opens argv[0], reads its complete bytes, interprets the final eight bytes as two little-endian counters, decrements one, writes clones to generated names under C:/Windows/System/, rewrites counters, calls CreateProcessW at 0x14002b01d, and loops. The counter/stride loop at 0x14002b023 follows the launched clone path. This is additional code before the ordinary XMRig controller/miner, not stock mining alone.
Embedded XMRig configuration enables cn/r mining at 3.120.209.58:8080 with user/pass x and donation zero. Pool literals corroborate configuration; no endpoint is used in a new detection.

Appended PE at 0xfc400 is a Go downloader. COFF symbols resolve main.checkForAdmin, main.main, main.GetArchive and main.Extract. Admin check opens PHYSICALDRIVE0; a non-admin launches powershell.exe Start-Process -FilePath <self> -Verb runAs, requesting normal user elevation, not bypassing UAC.

Go main downloads https://s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/cumulodirifiuti/pieghevole.zip, extracts under C:/G DATA Security Software/, removes the temporary ZIP and starts AVK.exe. GetArchive binds http.Get response to io.Copy into os.Create; Extract uses zip.OpenReader and file path checking. The remote archive was not fetched or executed. Its payload and legitimacy cannot be established from its name.

Appended PE at 0x5b8601 is an x86 reflective Beacon DLL exporting _ReflectiveLoader@4. Decoded XOR-0x69 ordered settings table at relative offset 0x2f228 has DNS mode, port 443, sleep 5000ms and endpoints ns7/ns8/ns9.softline.top, with Amazon-shaped HTTP paths/headers and rundll32 spawn paths.

Beacon code includes native task execution/HTTP receive, process writes at VA 0x10005785 and context takeover with SetThreadContext/ResumeThread at 0x1000634e/0x1000635e. Its reflective loader and PEB/ROR13 import-resolution code support existing injection and obfuscation findings.

The outer executable does not establish that either appended PE is launched. Its final trailer bytes are text-like and yield very large counters; failed staging/launch is plausible. Existing retained-code findings do not claim observed success.
samples.balance_and_missing_context: XMRig and Beacon can be used with authorization, and the appended Go stage requests ordinary elevation. The custom self-clone launch loop in a Windows system directory alongside configured mining and an implant tips this artifact to MALICIOUS. No deployment authorization or runtime success is established.

samples.identification: StormAttack native resource-DLL injection and persistence loader
samples.marker: StormAttack loader: hidden persistence, DLL injection and self-delete
evidence: PE32 entry 0x402674 reaches dispatch at 0x401cb0. Configuration DWORD at file offset 0x4120 is 3: branch at 0x401f75 selects Active Setup self-copy and shell cleanup.

Routine 0x401900 creates HKLM Software/Microsoft/Active Setup/Installed Components/<GUID> and writes a REG_EXPAND_SZ StubPath at 0x401a4b. It reads its own module, changes configuration, writes a copy and launches that copy.

Cleanup 0x401390 obtains its current module/short path and COMSPEC, constructs /c del <self> > nul and calls CreateProcessA. Hidden/System attributes (6) and the auto-start-service installation code are present in alternate modes.

DLL extraction helper 0x402460 obtains resource 101 of type DLL; 0x4023c0 writes resource bytes using CreateFileA/WriteFile. Alternate mode 1 calls 0x401260 to replace LanmanServer Parameters/ServiceDLL with a constructed StormServer DLL path.

Injection routine 0x401150 creates an Internet Explorer/notepad/calc target chosen by configuration, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL path, resolves kernel32!LoadLibraryA and passes it plus the remote buffer to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.

Resource at 0x5060, size 0x9c00, retains Storm ddos DNS and STORM message formats but has zeroed code/import regions and an all-zero entry point at RVA 0x741a. This does not establish an operational DNS/DDoS implant, Remcos or ransomware.

Percent-decoded facts originate in GUID printf format specifiers, not an obfuscated network address. The built-in metadata/encoded-payload/url finding correctly says percent-encoded content was decoded; it establishes neither a URL nor intentional concealment.
samples.balance_and_missing_context: An installer can copy files and register services, but this loader hides copies, hijacks an OS service DLL, injects into unrelated processes and erases itself with StormAttack identity evidence. The payload is damaged, which limits successful effects without making the remaining loader benign. Deployment authorization is unknown.

samples.identification: NanoCoreUltimate-labelled managed surveillance and ransomware build
samples.marker: NanoCoreUltimate build: keylogging and sabotage; add IFEO/task traits
evidence: CIL was disassembled with dnfile/dncil and all relevant metadata call/string tokens resolved. Assembly www.xoilac-tv.ru.com_nano contains NanoCoreUltimate.Program; the namespace alone is not attribution to the established NanoCore family.

Entry token 0x06000085 Main directly enables hiding, security weakening, UAC hijack, shadow deletion, IFEO interception, persistence and keylogging; it launches surveillance/sabotage workers through resolved delegates.

HookCallback at RVA 0x4694 reads keyboard events and appends timestamp/window/key records. A separate StartKeylogger worker polls virtual keys 1..254 with GetAsyncKeyState high-bit checks, appends to the same buffer and flushes KEYLOG records. Clipboard worker and ContinuousScreenshot record input and JPEG screenshots.

RecoverBrowserPasswords reads Chromium Login Data and Firefox logins.json as raw bytes. Wallet routines read wallet files. ReadBrowserData and AccessWindowsCredentialManager copy browser/Windows credential-store files into the staging directory. No browser or credential-store decryption is established.

SendToC2 at RVA 0x30c8 first appends records to desktop and temporary log files. IsPlaceholder at RVA 0x2910 unconditionally returns true; therefore its WebClient AES/Base64 POST loops are skipped. Existing upload findings describe retained code/co-occurrence, not demonstrated delivery. No active external exfiltration is claimed.

InstallPersistence at RVA 0x43ac writes self location to HKCU/HKLM Run keys, copies to Startup, and invokes schtasks for an onlogon task and a separate /sc minute /mo 30 task. The latter is a system-managed recurring trigger, not another login trigger.

ImageFileExecutionOptions at RVA 0x75d8 reads Application.ExecutablePath, iterates taskmgr.exe/regedit.exe/msconfig.exe, creates HKLM IFEO/<target> and sets Debugger to self. This distinct tool-interception mechanism was missing hostile coverage; the new profile requires independently established keylogging and IFEO key/write/tool evidence.

RealEncryption async state machine at RVA 0x5208 recursively enumerates Desktop/TestFolder, reads files, calls EncryptAES, writes .encrypted versions and deletes originals after a successful write. The static AES IV H1ddenT3ars1v!! is only 15 bytes, so set_IV throws and per-file catches prevent successful file replacement in this build. Existing traits describe code or encryption attempts and remain accurate.

Main attempts Defender disabling/exclusions, service stopping, security-site hosts poisoning, SafeBoot removal, shadow deletion, input blocking, ransomware wallpaper/notes, task-tool kills and creation of an administrator account. These concrete operations defeat a benign explanation based solely on the limited test encryption folder or disabled sender.

ProcessHollowing has suspended-launch, unmap, remote write, context and resume calls but a four-byte placeholder payload. DumpLSASS opens a process and records ACCESS_GRANTED without copying LSASS memory. CorruptSystemFiles uses FileMode.Append (6), not overwrite: it attempts to append 1024 random bytes to system DLLs. No working memory dumper, injected payload, disk wiper or header corruption is inferred.

CreateFakeDecryptor copies its own executable under a decryptor-looking filename and marks it hidden; it does not decrypt files. Existing file-copy/attribute and ransom evidence is retained without inventing a family signature from the chosen filename.
samples.balance_and_missing_context: A partially disarmed lab build is plausible: uploads are blocked and file encryption is limited and broken. It still records private input and attempts broad host sabotage, concealed persistence, tool interception and a backdoor administrator account by default. Those concrete hostile effects tip the judgement to MALICIOUS without assuming deployment circumstances.

retention_recovery: The extra positive disappeared from samples during this task; forager recovered the exact SHA-256 through Hopper. Its artifact and .forage.json provenance remain in scratch/fallout-pe-review/recovered; comparison uses content hashes.
